alertas_do_dia.titulo: KO · Coca-Cola or Chevron: The One Dividend Stock I’d Hold for the Next 20 Years
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 13/10 17h02 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Key Takeaways - Chevron yields 3.4%, and Coca-Cola 2.5%, and Chevron raised its dividend faster from fiscal 2020 to fiscal 2025: 5.8% a year to Coca-Cola's 4.5%.
– - Over the last twelve months, Chevron's dividend took 51% of its free cash flow, against 77% for Coca-Cola.
– - Coca-Cola's free cash flow fell short of its dividend in fiscal 2024 and 2025, then rebounded to $6.9 billion in the first half of 2026.
– - Chevron's own 2030 targets assume commodity prices lower than today's, so oil prices are the thing to watch.
– Free cash flow hit $18.1 billion in the second quarter of 2026, up from $4.9 billion a year earlier, and production rose 20%.
– Net revenues grew 7% to $13.4 billion, and unit case volume rose 5%.
Link: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/coca-cola-chevron-one-dividend-200203497.html

– JPMorgan Chase & Co (NYSE:JPM, XETRA:CMC), the US banking group, reported third-quarter net income of $15.3 billion, up 6% year on year, but missed analysts' forecasts for earnings and revenue.
– The bank earned $5.57 per share on reported revenue of $50.2 billion, below market expectations of $5.93 per share and $51.23 billion in revenue.
– A $658 million loss on investment securities reduced earnings per share by $0.18, while net income excluding the item reached $15.8 billion, or $5.75 per share.

– Managed revenue, which adjusts reported figures to help assess business performance, rose 8% to $50.9 billion, supported by stronger interest income and higher revenue across several operating divisions.
– Net interest income, the difference between interest earned and interest paid, increased 13% to $27.1 billion, reflecting higher deposit balances and growth in card and wholesale lending.
– Market revenue climbed 15% to $10.3 billion, driven by a 49% increase in equity trading, which offset a 4% decline in fixed-income markets revenue.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: CVX · Verizon or Chevron: I Can Only Pick One Dividend Stock for the Next 10 Years. Here’s Mine
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 12/10 18h50 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Key Takeaways - Verizon yields 6.2% and Chevron 3.4%, and each paid out just over half its free cash flow as dividends in the 12 months to June 30, 2026.
– - Chevron raised its dividend 5.8% a year from fiscal 2020 to fiscal 2025, against 1.9% for Verizon, and carries far less debt.
– - Chevron's coverage depends on oil prices: its free cash flow fell far short of its dividend in fiscal 2020.
– - Verizon's debt, at 3.35x EBITDA, is the main risk to watch as it keeps raising its dividend.
– Verizon (VZ:NYSE) grew free cash flow 24.4% to $6.4 billion in the second quarter of 2026 from a year earlier, and it expects 9% to 10% free cash flow growth for the full year.
– Chevron (CVX:NYSE) went bigger: $18.1 billion of free cash flow in the second quarter of 2026, against $4.9 billion a year before, as production jumped 20%.
Link: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/verizon-chevron-only-pick-one-215050924.html

alertas_do_dia.titulo: TSLA · Jefferies raises Tesla price target as resilient deliveries support automotive outlook
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 12/10 11h44 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):

– Jefferies has raised its price target for Tesla Inc (NASDAQ:TSLA), the electric carmaker, to $400 from $350, as resilient vehicle deliveries and improving prospects for non-automotive businesses offset concerns over ris…
– Analyst Philippe Houchois maintained a 'hold' rating, with the revised target implying 5% upside from Tesla's closing price of $382.70 cited in the 12 October research note.
– Jefferies expects third-quarter revenue of $29.2 billion, an automotive gross margin of 16.7% and adjusted operating profit of $781 million, while forecasting cash outflow of about $5 billion.
– Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles during the quarter, up 1% from the previous three months but down 2% year on year, with its Model 3 and Model Y accounting for 478,200 deliveries.
– Production reached 464,400 vehicles, leaving output below deliveries, although Jefferies expects year-to-date production and deliveries to remain broadly aligned and support working capital.

– The broker forecast automotive revenue of $21 billion, with a limited contribution of $140 million from regulatory credits, while stronger software uptake and improved vehicle resale values could support margins.
Link: https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/jefferies-raises-tesla-price-target-144400027.html

– Os papéis preferenciais subiram 1,27%, enquanto os ordinários tiveram alta de 1,33%.
– A PRIO ganhou 3,17%, favorecida pelo desempenho do petróleo.

– Nesta terça-feira (13), o principal índice da bolsa brasileira terminou as negociações com baixa de 1,04%, aos 206.887,52 pontos.

– Já no levantamento Futura, Flávio registra 50%, contra 46,6% de Lula, diferença de 3,4 pontos percentuais.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: PLTR · If Palantir Stock Looks Expensive, You Need To Read This
corpo: Yahoo Finance · 13/10 16h39 · fonte única · licença: resumo
Trechos (licença resumo: reescrever, não colar):
– Shares of Palantir Technologies (PLTR) currently trade at 137.7 times its adjusted earnings over the past twelve months, a metric that adds stock-based pay back after tax.
– How Much You Pay For Palantir's Coming Earnings Based on the consensus forecast for fiscal 2026, which concludes this December, Palantir trades at 121.5 times earnings.
– Looking further ahead to the forecast for fiscal 2027, the valuation falls to 81.7 times.
– Both figures offer a stark contrast to the 137.7 multiple applied to the past twelve months.
– Palantir earned $3.7 billion on that adjusted basis over the past twelve months.
– Projections call for the company to earn $4.1 billion in fiscal 2026 and $6.2 billion in fiscal 2027.

alertas_do_dia.titulo: USDBRL · Tempo real: Ibovespa cai 1% com disputa acirrada entre Flávio e Lula; dólar sobe a R$ 5,02
corpo: Money Times · 13/10 15h39 · fonte única · licença: integral
Do texto:

– O agronegócio paulista registrou superávit de US$ 15,61 bilhões nos nove primeiros meses de 2026, informou a Diretoria de Pesquisa dos Agronegócios (Apta), da Secretaria de Agricultura e Abastecimento de São Paulo.
– As exportações somaram US$ 20,08 bilhões, enquanto as importações alcançaram US$ 4,47 bilhões.
– No período, o setor respondeu por 36,1% das exportações totais do Estado, enquanto as importações do agronegócio representaram 6,4% do total estadual.
– O complexo sucroalcooleiro respondeu por 25,3% do total exportado pelo agronegócio paulista, com US$ 5,07 bilhões.
– Desse total, açúcar representou 93,2% e etanol, 6,8%.
– O grupo de carnes veio em seguida, com 16,7% das vendas externas do setor (US$ 3,35 bilhões), com a carne bovina respondendo por 83,4%.

– - Jamie Dimon said that the bank will protect against "rogue agents" by keeping most out.

– The typical security concerns around any new adaptation of technology are "heightened" with AI agents, "because you don't want rogue agents, and there could be thousands of them," JPMorgan Chase CEO Dimon said during an…
– "In the meantime, we're not going to allow just any outside agent to come in inside the company because that's just too risky for clients and for JPMorgan," Dimon said.
– The bank is already blocking access to "to the extent that we're able to block those," Jeremy Barnum, the bank's chief financial officer, said.
– "I think right now, some of the services that offer that do it through credential sharing, and we have a long record of being against that way of doing things, screen scraping, et cetera," he said.

– Na última semana, o índice de Small Caps (SMLL) disparou 20,14%, enquanto o Ibovespa (IBOV) apresentou valorização de 8,82%.
– Entre os destaques aparecem a transportadora JSL (JSLG3), as incorporadoras Cury (CURY3), Plano & Plano (PLPL3), Direcional (DIRR3) e a construtora Moura Dubeux (MDNE3).
